basic_info.description: Penthouse-level living in the heart of the vibrant Castro Neighborhood! This modern 2 bedroom, 2 bath residence is perched atop a boutique building. Located on the corner of the building the unique vantage point offers rare and sweeping views from Twin Peaks to the downtown skyline. Bright and airy, the home features skylights, a custom marble topped kitchen island, motorized custom window treatments and sleek finishes throughout. Enjoy the conveniences of in-unit laundry, a large private storage unit, and 1 car parking. Ideally located just steps to eclectic dining, shopping, nightlife, transit and even a summer farmers market right across the street!  This is quintessential city living at its best! Don't miss this rare one of a kind penthouse unit.
